page.layout: One column of running text. Notes in the left margin: a multi-line side note beside the opening lines, and a date note at the foot of the text beside the lines "in fine hujus anni". Running head at the top. Page number at the top left.
page.running_head: De Agro Frisiorum inter Lavic. & Amasiorum

main_text.p: dowoldii, autore civitate Episcopum etiam eundem pactis conventis sibi obligarunt: quorum hæc summa: Episcopus promisit, juri, libertati, ditionibus ordinum agrariorum, cujusmodi tum erant, impedimento se nunquam futurum, modo ipsi vicissim in Vltrajectinos injurij non sint, & cum civitate Groninganâ in eadem amicitiâ, societate, & institutis præsentibus permaneant constantes, imo contra oppressores gratiâ & consilio ipsis adfuturum, item procuraturum, ne quid injuriæ àsuis, aut perditionem suum cuiquam eorum inferatur impunè: nec ullum se castellum ullamvè munitionem excitaturum aut receptūrum in agro hoc, unde agrariis ordinibus periculum creari queat. Hoc factum ipso æstivi solstitii die. Et cùm suspicionis aliquid, ceu fieri in mutationibus solet, Fivelingiis esset injectum, seorsim rursus hi cum civitate, & civitas cum iis pacti fuēre in fine hujus anni, minuendæ libertatis, ditionum, juris sociorum autores se non futuros ullo tempore, imo minuere conantes alios repressuros pro virium modo, salvis tamen fœderibus, & pactis omnibus prioribus.

page.notes: Left margin note beside the opening lines (set in several short lines, hyphenated): Conventio inter Episcopū VL-trajecti:& ordines agrarios. The side note is printed in small type and is included as a note on the first paragraph. Two notes in the left margin: the first beside "quorum hæc summa", the second beside "in fine hujus anni", reading "M. CCCC" and "XVII." on two lines. The printed date note is marked with the year and the number, copied as printed. Doubtful: the reading "tempore" (the final letter is abbreviated in the scan); the italic and roman boundaries in the lower half are approximate, since the scan is low-contrast there; "receptūrum" (the macron is faint). Faint watermark at the bottom right is not printed text and is left out.
